care.summary: Vibrant variegated heart-leaf philodendron with lime-green and dark-green striped leaves; fast-growing and forgiving.
care.light: Bright indirect light for best variegation; tolerates low light
care.water: Keep soil lightly moist; water when top inch is dry
care.humidity: Moderate to high; benefits from occasional misting
care.fertilizer: Balanced liquid fertilizer monthly in growing season
common_issues: Reverting to all-green in low light
tips: Provide a moss pole for climbing
Rotate for even growth and variegation
Easy to propagate from stem cuttings in water
